Messages.Author: De Nada
Messages.Body:
What can vampires in torpor do ?

Can they vote ?

Can they play reaction cards ?

Can they receive blood from the palatial estate ?

Can they move blood off of themselves with a blood doll ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
De Nada wrote:
>
> What can vampires in torpor do ?
>
> Can they vote ?

No. [6.3.3.2]

> Can they play reaction cards ?

No. [6.5.1]

> Can they receive blood from the palatial estate ?

Yes (card text doesn't require "Ready" - contrast with Hunting Grounds)

> Can they move blood off of themselves with a blood doll ?

You can move blood off of them via a Blood Doll, yes, since card text
doesn't require "Ready".

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 25 Sep 2000 11:05:40 -0500, "De Nada" <a...@media.net> wrote:

>What can vampires in torpor do ?

BE DIABLERIZED! Or rescue themselves. Or play any actions that read
"Usable by a vampire in torpor." That's it! =) Diablerie is most
fun.

>Can they vote ?

No.

>Can they play reaction cards ?

No. Cept for "Reform Body".

>Can they receive blood from the palatial estate ?

Card text:

"This equipment card represents a unique location. The cost for this
location is paid by a vampire; put this card on that vampire. The
vampire with this location gains 1 blood at the beginning of each of
your master phases. (Ignore excess blood.)"

Yep! It doesn't specify "ready" vampire.

>Can they move blood off of themselves with a blood doll ?

Since you, the Methuselah, are doing the "moving", yes. Or you could
put one back onto them if you wanted.

-- Derek
